en.text: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西娶了古实女子为妻。米利暗和亚伦因他所娶的古实女子就毁谤他，说：

zhTraditional.text: 摩西娶了古實女子為妻。米利暗和亞倫因他所娶的古實女子就毀謗他，說：

en.text: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

zhSimplified.text: 「难道耶和华单与摩西说话，不也与我们说话吗？」这话耶和华听见了。

zhTraditional.text: 「難道耶和華單與摩西說話，不也與我們說話嗎？」這話耶和華聽見了。（

en.text: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西为人极其谦和，胜过世上的众人。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西為人極其謙和，勝過世上的眾人。）

en.text: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华忽然对摩西、亚伦、米利暗说：「你们三个人都出来，到会幕这里。」他们三个人就出来了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華忽然對摩西、亞倫、米利暗說：「你們三個人都出來，到會幕這裏。」他們三個人就出來了。

en.text: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华在云柱中降临，站在会幕门口，召亚伦和米利暗，二人就出来了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華在雲柱中降臨，站在會幕門口，召亞倫和米利暗，二人就出來了。

en.text: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：「你们且听我的话：你们中间若有先知，我—耶和华必在异象中向他显现，在梦中与他说话。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：「你們且聽我的話：你們中間若有先知，我－耶和華必在異象中向他顯現，在夢中與他說話。

en.text: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

zhSimplified.text: 我的仆人摩西不是这样；他是在我全家尽忠的。

zhTraditional.text: 我的僕人摩西不是這樣；他是在我全家盡忠的。

en.text: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

zhSimplified.text: 我要与他面对面说话，乃是明说，不用谜语，并且他必见我的形象。你们毁谤我的仆人摩西，为何不惧怕呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 我要與他面對面說話，乃是明說，不用謎語，並且他必見我的形像。你們毀謗我的僕人摩西，為何不懼怕呢？」

en.text: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华就向他们二人发怒而去。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華就向他們二人發怒而去。

en.text: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

zhSimplified.text: 云彩从会幕上挪开了，不料，米利暗长了大麻风，有雪那样白。亚伦一看米利暗长了大麻风，

zhTraditional.text: 雲彩從會幕上挪開了，不料，米利暗長了大痲瘋，有雪那樣白。亞倫一看米利暗長了大痲瘋，

en.text: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

zhSimplified.text: 就对摩西说：「我主啊，求你不要因我们愚昧犯罪，便将这罪加在我们身上。

zhTraditional.text: 就對摩西說：「我主啊，求你不要因我們愚昧犯罪，便將這罪加在我們身上。

en.text: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

zhSimplified.text: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半烂的死胎。」

zhTraditional.text: 求你不要使她像那出母腹、肉已半爛的死胎。」

en.text: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

zhSimplified.text: 于是摩西哀求耶和华说：「 神啊，求你医治她！」

zhTraditional.text: 於是摩西哀求耶和華說：「上帝啊，求你醫治她！」

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「她父亲若吐唾沫在她脸上，她岂不蒙羞七天吗？现在要把她在营外关锁七天，然后才可以领她进来。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「她父親若吐唾沫在她臉上，她豈不蒙羞七天嗎？現在要把她在營外關鎖七天，然後才可以領她進來。」

en.text: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

zhSimplified.text: 于是米利暗关锁在营外七天。百姓没有行路，直等到把米利暗领进来。

zhTraditional.text: 於是米利暗關鎖在營外七天。百姓沒有行路，直等到把米利暗領進來。

en.text: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

zhSimplified.text: 以后百姓从哈洗录起行，在巴兰的旷野安营。

zhTraditional.text: 以後百姓從哈洗錄起行，在巴蘭的曠野安營。
